request.style: English, warm female vocal, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, gentle and reassuring mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not grumble like they did
They were destroyed by the destroyer
Written down for us to see
Examples for the present day

[Chorus]
No temptation has overtaken you
Except what is common to humanity
God is faithful in his word
He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear

[Verse]
Whoever thinks he is standing firm
Should watch out that he does not fall
We are on whom the end has come
But he provides a way out

[Chorus]
No temptation has overtaken you
Except what is common to humanity
God is faithful in his word
He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear

[Bridge]
With the temptation he provides
A path so that you can endure
Flee from idolatry today
Judge for yourselves what I say

[Chorus]
No temptation has overtaken you
Except what is common to humanity
God is faithful in his word
He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear

[Outro]
So that you can endure it
He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear
